title: Studio: new field's API name doesn't follow the label before first save (permanent field_N columns)
body:
Mirror of framework#2615 (P1), found by the Studio package-create UX dogfood (framework#2609). Reproduced against the pinned console build `7782698`.

## What happens

"Add field" creates a field with API name `field_2` / label "New field". Relabeling to `Status` leaves the API name `field_2`, and after publish the data column is `field_2` forever — verified: the saved record stores `"field_2": "in_progress"`.

## Why it's a trap

Object and app identifiers **do** auto-suggest from the display name (Repair Ticket → `repair_ticket`, Repair Center → `repair_center`), so authors expect the same for fields and never look at the API-name input. The result is data models full of meaningless `field_N` columns that leak into the REST API, formulas, and exports.

## Expected

Sync the API name from the label while the field is new/unsaved (exactly the object-identifier behavior), lock it after first save. If the label is CJK-only and no suggestion can be derived, keep `field_N` but visually flag the API-name input so the author notices.
